---
title: "Nexus"
subtitle: "NEXtflow's Ultimate Streamliner"
---

A command-line interface for running bioinformatics workflows written in [Nextflow](https://www.nextflow.io/).

::: {.callout-tip}
## Three commands. That's it.
```bash
nexus avail                                           # see what's available
nexus run --nf-workflow <WORKFLOW.nf> --help          # see the parameters
nexus run --nf-workflow <WORKFLOW.nf> [parameters]    # run it
```
:::

## Quick Start

### 1. Install

```bash
conda create -n nexus python=3.10
conda activate nexus
conda install bioconda::nextflow==24.10.0
pip install nexus-<version>.tar.gz --verbose
```

Download the latest release from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/pirl-unc/nexus/releases).

### 2. Pick a Workflow

```bash
nexus avail
```

### 3. Run

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Subworkflow (single tool)

```bash
nexus run --nf-workflow variant_calling_mutect2.nf \
    -c nextflow.config \
    -w work/ \
    --samples_tsv_file samples.tsv \
    --reference_genome_fasta_file hg38.fa \
    --output_dir results/
```

#### Workflow (multiple tools)

```bash
nexus run --nf-workflow variant_calling_short-read-dna-somatic.nf \
    -params-file params.yaml
```

:::

::: {.callout-note}
Nextflow config files are available
[here](https://github.com/pirl-unc/nexus/tree/main/nextflow).
Use the config file that matches your installed nexus version (e.g. `nexus_v0.2.0_nextflow_slurm.config`).
:::

## How Nexus is Organized

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-4}
### Tools
Individual process definitions that wrap a single bioinformatics tool (e.g., `samtools`, `gatk4`, `minimap2`).
:::

::: {.g-col-4}
### Subworkflows
Single-tool workflows that compose one or more tool processes into a complete analysis step (e.g., `variant_calling_mutect2`).
:::

::: {.g-col-4}
### Workflows
Meta-workflows that orchestrate multiple subworkflows into end-to-end pipelines (e.g., `variant_calling_short-read-dna-somatic`).
:::

:::

## What's Available

Check out the [Subworkflows](subworkflows/index.qmd) and [Workflows](workflows/index.qmd) pages for the specific details.

## Dependencies

* python (>=3.10)
* nextflow (>=24.10.0)
* biopython
* matplotlib
* networkx (>=3.0)
* numpy (>=1.26)
* pandas (>=2.0.3)
* pysam
* pyyaml
